metadata.question: Does Australia show higher carbon monoxide concentration than Indonesia in October 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for CO (carbon monoxide) concentration. - Sentinel-5P has global CO measurements. - Time period: October 2024 (2024-10-01 to 2024-10-31). - Locations: Australia and Indonesia (define representative geometries). 2. **Masking strategy**: - CO data from Sentinel-5P doesn't require cloud masking in the same way as optical data. - We'll use QA values if available to filter poor quality pixels. - Focus on mean CO concentration for each country. 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null (C3)**: - Check if data exists for both countries. - Verify pixel counts > 0 after filtering. - Compare mean CO values; ensure they are in valid range (0-1000 ppb for tropospheric CO). - If either country has 0 valid pixels → C2. - If either country has no data → C1. - If values are None or out of range → C3. - Then compare: Australia mean > Indonesia mean → A, else → B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Australia and Indonesia const australia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[113.0, -44.0], [154.0, -44.0], [154.0, -10.0], [113.0, -10.0], [113.0, -44.0]] ]); const indonesia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[95.0, -11.0], [141.0, -11.0], [141.0, 6.0], [95.0, 6.0], [95.0, -11.0]] ]); // 2. Load Sentinel-5P TROPOMI CO data for October 2024 const startDate = '2024-10-01'; const endDate = '2024-10-31'; const colCO = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_CO') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('CO_column_number_density'); print('CO Collection size: ' + colCO.size().getInfo()); // 3. Check if data exists const colSize = colCO.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { print('No Sentinel-5P CO data found for October 2024.'); print('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean CO for Australia const coAustralia = colCO.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: australia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanCO_Australia = coAustralia.get('CO_column_number_density').getInfo(); const countCO_Australia = colCO.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: australia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('CO_column_number_density').getInfo(); print('Australia: Mean CO = ' + (meanCO_Australia !== null ? meanCO_Australia.toFixed(6) : 'null') + ', Pixels: ' + countCO_Australia); // 5. Calculate mean CO for Indonesia const coIndonesia = colCO.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: indonesia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanCO_Indonesia = coIndonesia.get('CO_column_number_density').getInfo(); const countCO_Indonesia = colCO.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: indonesia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('CO_column_number_density').getInfo(); print('Indonesia: Mean CO = ' + (meanCO_Indonesia !== null ? meanCO_Indonesia.toFixed(6) : 'null') + ', Pixels: ' + countCO_Indonesia); // 6. Validation if (countCO_Australia === 0 || countCO_Indonesia === 0) { print('No valid pixels for one or both regions.'); print('C2'); return; } if (meanCO_Australia === null || meanCO_Indonesia === null) { print('CO calculation failed (null values).'); print('C3'); return; } if (meanCO_Australia < 0 || meanCO_Australia > 1000 || meanCO_Indonesia < 0 || meanCO_Indonesia > 1000) { print('CO values out of valid range.'); print('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare and answer print('Comparison: Australia (' + meanCO_Australia.toFixed(6) + ') vs Indonesia (' + meanCO_Indonesia.toFixed(6) + ')'); if (meanCO_Australia > meanCO_Indonesia) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
